sections.name: GameRenderer:createBackgroundCache
sections.code:
-- Draw Walls (Brick/Stone)
    for y = floorY, self.H do
        for x = 1, self.W do
            cacheMatrix:rect(x, y, 1, 1, C_WALL_BASE)
            
            -- Brick pattern
            local row = math.floor((y - floorY) / 5)
            local shift = (row % 2) * 4
            if (y - floorY) % 5 == 0 or (x + shift) % 8 == 0 then
                cacheMatrix:rect(x, y, 1, 1, C_WALL_SHADOW)
            end
            
            -- Vignette edges
            if x < 10 then
                if (x + y) % 2 == 0 then cacheMatrix:rect(x, y, 1, 1, 16) end
            end
